description: Repo-scale (makefile-buildsystem): a new src/net module needs BOTH its sources picked up AND its headers on the include path
prompts: Add a new module `src/net/` (net.h/net.c) with `net_format_addr(char *buf, size_t bufsize, const char *host, int port)`, formatting `"host:port"` into `buf` via snprintf. Wire it into src/cli/main.c (call it and print the result). In the Makefile: (1) add `NET_SRCS := $(wildcard src/net/*.c)` and include it in `SRCS`, so the new module's sources actually get compiled - `$(wildcard src/core/*.c)`-style globs don't pick up a brand new directory on their own; (2) ALSO add `-Isrc/net` to `CFLAGS`, so `main.c`'s `#include "net.h"` can actually resolve - adding the sources without the include path (or vice versa) breaks the build.

test_setup_files.check_net_module.py:
import subprocess

r = subprocess.run(['make', 'all'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
assert r.returncode == 0, f'make all failed:\n{r.stdout}\n{r.stderr}'

run = subprocess.run(['./bin/app'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=15)
assert run.returncode == 0, run.stdout + run.stderr
assert 'addr: localhost:8080' in run.stdout, run.stdout

print('PASS')

reference_solution.Makefile:
CC := gcc
CFLAGS := -std=c11 -Wall -MMD -MP -Isrc/core -Isrc/utils -Isrc/net

CORE_SRCS := $(wildcard src/core/*.c)
UTILS_SRCS := $(wildcard src/utils/*.c)
NET_SRCS := $(wildcard src/net/*.c)
CLI_SRCS := $(wildcard src/cli/*.c)
SRCS := $(CORE_SRCS) $(UTILS_SRCS) $(NET_SRCS) $(CLI_SRCS)
OBJS := $(SRCS:.c=.o)
DEPS := $(OBJS:.o=.d)

BINDIR := bin
TARGET := $(BINDIR)/app

TEST_SRCS := $(CORE_SRCS) $(UTILS_SRCS) tests/test_calc.c
TEST_TARGET := $(BINDIR)/test_calc

.PHONY: all clean test

all: $(TARGET)

$(TARGET): $(OBJS) | $(BINDIR)
	$(CC) $(OBJS) -o $(TARGET)

%.o: %.c
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) -c $< -o $@

$(BINDIR):
	mkdir -p $(BINDIR)

test: $(TEST_TARGET)
	./$(TEST_TARGET)

$(TEST_TARGET): $(TEST_SRCS) | $(BINDIR)
	$(CC) $(CFLAGS) $(TEST_SRCS) -o $(TEST_TARGET)

clean:
	rm -rf $(BINDIR) $(DEPS) $(OBJS)

-include $(DEPS)
